4009-4659-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4009-4659-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mox Opal by paying its mana cost.
When Mox Opal enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mox Opal by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mox Opal, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mox Opal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

2085-2645-3430-3861.easyPrerequisites: Kelpie Guide doesn't have summoning sickness.
2085-2645-3430-3861.description:
Activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Orzhov Basilica
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2390-4205-6191.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-4205-6191.description:
Gain life.
Bloodthirsty Aerialist triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1957-4050-5931--173.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature castable for {0}, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, Funeral Room triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast that creature by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1349-4153-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature with a coin counter on it.
1349-4153-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Resourceful Defense's ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting a coin counter onto itself as well as +1/+1 counters if those were present.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 1.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Resourceful Defense.
When Resourceful Defense dies, it and Athreos's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting a coin counter and +1/+1 counters onto the other nontoken creature.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Resourceful Defense from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 6.
Repeat.

586-3497-5258-5618-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3560-3899-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
3560-3899-5972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

5641-6890-6996-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5641-6890-6996-7810.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Repeat from step 2.

338-5641-6830-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-5641-6830-7810.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

2843-2921-3175.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

460-539-7203.description:
Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G} or {W}{W}.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Brigid
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2366-2800-5702-6633.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-2800-5702-6633.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mirari's Wake triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

277-2893-3470-5455.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Tiller Engine.
When the basic land enters, Tiller Engine, Lotus Cobra and Bristly Bill trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the basic land.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Bristly Bill trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1636-4023-6798-6987.notablePrerequisites: Need to have a total of 5 artifact creatures
1636-4023-6798-6987.description:
Cast Robobrain War Mind by paying {3}{U}.
When Robobrain War Mind enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Robobrain War Mind trigger, causing you to get {E} for each artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Robobrain War Mind.
Activate Dr. Madison Li by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Robobrain War Mind from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

24-5759-6899.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Screaming Nemesis instead of you due to With Great Power... if you chose the largest number.
Screaming Nemesis triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
24-5759-6899.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

880-2783-6763.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-2783-6763.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control.
If the creature was a Dragon Egg, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the land enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2457-3480-4289-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

500-851-2523-4094.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
500-851-2523-4094.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Adrix and Nev and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put all but one Adrix and Nev token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Adrix and Nevs dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2^X nonlegendary token copies of Adrix and Nev that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Adrix and Nevs you control plus one.
Repeat step 5 for the remaining triggers.
500-851-2523-4094.notes: Assuming you control no other token doublers, this combo will make a total of 10^(10^308.0343553279263) creature tokens.

4475-6439.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control have total toughness 40 or greater.
4475-6439.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Betor and Wound Reflection trigger.
Resolve the Betor trigger, causing each opponent to half their life total, rounded up.
Resolve the Wound Reflection trigger, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they've lost this turn.

1561-6254.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
Your life total is at least 2.
Your deck size is even.
1561-6254.description: Cast Peer into the Abyss by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}, causing you to lose half your life total rounded up and draw your library due to Vnwxt.

797-1617-4831-4983-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
You have enough mana to cast Stolen Identity.
797-1617-4831-4983-5358.description:
Cast Stolen Identity by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and the nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur each trigger twice.
Resolve all Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having the token and nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur fight Cacophodon.
797-1617-4831-4983-5358.notes: Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters, you may instead have Cacophodon fight another creature you control.

372-813-1567.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Momentary Blink exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-813-1567.description:
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Scholar of the Ages and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Scholar of the Ages trigger.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Momentary Blink from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Momentary Blink.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Scholar of the Ages and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2104-3277-5626.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} the first turn, with {5}{U}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
2104-3277-5626.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
You have at least {E}{E}
2104-3277-5626.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Izzet Chronarch from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}, sacrificing Izzet Chronarch, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1270-3899-4050.description:

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spawn, adding {1}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing two Spawns, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.

2438-2867-4636-5391.description:

When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Robot.
When the Robot dies, Demon of Dark Schemes' second ability triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

222-2393-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Saproling.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
222-2393-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing another nontoken creature you control and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {1}{B}.
When the creatures die, Sifter of Skulls triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the two Eldrazi Scions, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
